newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker levels weak amid few enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker levels weak amid few enquiries.

text.p: The Singapore bunker quotes stayed at around their recent weak levels on Thursday as enquiries did not improve amid poor demand.
The 380-cst was heard offered at $96/$99 per tonne and the 180-cst at $102/$106. MDO and gas oil were quoted at around $190 and $200 respectively.

"It's very quiet today. Demand is very thin from shipowners and some suppliers did not even bother to offer when the market is so bearish," said one trader. Some independents quoted the 380-cst grade at as low as $95 per tonne, traders said.
